CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 23
(1) The community is responsible for carrying out prevention, risk reduction, and handling of cases of women who are victims of violence, exploitation, and trafficking in persons.
(2) The community's responsibility as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women;
b. providing information and/or reporting to law enforcement officers or the competent authorities if acts of violence occur;
c. protecting victims; and
d. providing emergency assistance.

MAYOR OF BANDAR LAMPUNG
LAMPUNG PROVINCE
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANDAR LAMPUNG CITY
NUMBER: 03 YEAR 2019
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN
BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD
MAYOR OF BANDAR LAMPUNG,

Considering : a. that in the context of fulfilling the constitutional rights of women, every citizen has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity, has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence and to improve the quality of life of women which is one of the responsibilities of the Regional Government; b. that in the effort to fulfill women's rights, efforts need to be made by families, communities, and the Regional Government, as referred to in letter a, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women; In View of : 1. Article 18 paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia; 2. Law Number 28 Year 1959 concerning Stipulation of Emergency Law Number 4 Year 1956 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1956 Number 55, Emergency Law Number 5 Year 1956 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1956 Number 57) concerning Establishment of Level II Regions Including Municipality Within the Level I Region of South Sumatra as Law (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1959 Number 73, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 1821); 3. Law Number 7 Year 1984 concerning Ratification of the Convention on the Elimination of all forms of Discrimination Against Women (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1984 Number 29, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3277); 4. Law Number 19 Year 1999 concerning Ratification of ILO Convention Number 105 Concerning The Abolition Of Forced Labour (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1999 Number 55, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3834); 5. Law Number 39 Year 1999 concerning Human Rights (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1999 Number 165, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3886); 6. Law Number 13 Year 2003 concerning Manpower (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2003 Number 39, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia 4279); 7. Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning Elimination of Domestic Violence (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2004 Number 95, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4419); 8. Law Number 13 Year 2006 concerning Protection of Witnesses and Victims (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2006 Number 64, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4635); 9. Law Number 21 Year 2007 concerning Eradication of the Criminal Act of Trafficking in Persons (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2007 Number 58, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4720); 10. Law Number 11 Year 2008 concerning Information and Electronic Transactions (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2008 Number 58, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4843); 11. Law Number 11 Year 2009 concerning Social Welfare (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2009 Number 12, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4967); 12. Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2014 Number 244, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5587) as has been amended several times most recently by Law Number 9 Year 2015 concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 Year 2014 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2015 Number 58, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5679); 13. Government Regulation Number 3 Year 1982 concerning Amendment of Regional Boundaries of Level II Municipality of Tanjungkarang-Telukbetung (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1982 Number 6, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3213); 14. Government Regulation Number 24 Year 1983 concerning Change of Name of Level II Municipality of Tanjungkarang-Telukbetung to Level II Municipality of Bandar Lampung (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1983 Number 30, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3254); 15. Government Regulation Number 4 Year 2006 concerning Implementation and Cooperation for Recovery of Victims of Domestic Violence, (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2006 Number 15, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4604); 16. Government Regulation Number 09 Year 2008 Concerning Procedures and Mechanisms for Integrated Services for Witnesses/Victims of the Criminal Act of Trafficking in Persons (TPPO) (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2008 Number 22, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4818); 17. Government Regulation Number 39 Year 2012 concerning Implementation of Social Welfare (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2012 Number 68, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5294); 18. Regulation of the Minister of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Number 2 Year 2008 concerning Guidelines for Implementation of Protection of Women (State News of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2008 Number 2 Year 2008); 19. Regulation of the Minister of Home Affairs Number 15 Year 2008 concerning General Guidelines for Implementation of Gender Mainstreaming in Regions, as has been amended by Regulation of the Minister of Home Affairs Number 67 Year 2011 (State News of the Republic of Indonesia Number 67 Year 2011); 20.

Article 14
(1) Legal assistance constitutes legal services provided by legal companions and advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Accompanying and/or defending in every legal handling process;
b. preparing reports on the progress of legal handling.

Article 24
The business sector has the obligation and responsibility to:
a. provide contribution and guarantee in the implementation of the administration of women's protection;
b. provide facilities and infrastructure to enhance efforts for the fulfillment of rights and protection of women; and
c. be responsible for conducting prevention, risk reduction and handling of cases of women victims of violence, exploitation, human trafficking.

CHAPTER III
SCOPE
Article 3
The Scope of Protection of Women includes: a. Prevention;
b. Services; and
c. Empowerment.

Article 17
(1) In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family life, society, nation, and state, women must be empowered.
(2) The empowerment of women as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed towards obtaining their opportunities and rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in economic, socio-cultural, political, and legal activities.

INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK FOR THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN
Part One
Guidance, Coordination, Implementation and Supervision of the Protection of Women

Rights of Victims

Article 16
(1) Social reintegration constitutes efforts to reunite victims with their family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Economic and social empowerment;
b. Education; and
c. Monitoring and/or further guidance.

Article 25
(1) The Mayor conducts guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision of the protection of women.
(2) The Mayor may delegate the guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision, as referred to in paragraph (1), to the Regional Apparatus Organization that carries out the main duties and functions in the field of the protection of women.
(3) The procedures and mechanisms for guidance, coordination, implementation, and supervision shall be further regulated by a Mayor Regulation.

CRIMINAL PROVISIONS
Article 28
Any person or entity/institution/organization that deliberately fails to fulfill the rights and protection of women may be subject to criminal sanctions in accordance with applicable regulations and laws.

Article 26
(1) The implementation of women's protection services is carried out in an integrated manner by UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
(2) The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by the Mayor's Regulation.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 23
(1) The community is responsible for carrying out prevention, risk reduction, and handling of cases of women who are victims of violence, exploitation, and trafficking in persons.
(2) The community's responsibility as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women;
b. providing information and/or reporting to law enforcement officers or the competent authorities if acts of violence occur;
c. protecting victims; and
d. providing emergency assistance.

Article 26
(1) The implementation of women's protection services is carried out in an integrated manner by UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
(2) The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by the Mayor's Regulation.

Article 25
(1) The Mayor conducts guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision of the protection of women.
(2) The Mayor may delegate the guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision, as referred to in paragraph (1), to the Regional Apparatus Organization that carries out the main duties and functions in the field of the protection of women.
(3) The procedures and mechanisms for guidance, coordination, implementation, and supervision shall be further regulated by a Mayor Regulation.

Article 26
(1) The implementation of women's protection services is carried out in an integrated manner by UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
(2) The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by the Mayor's Regulation.

Article 24
The business sector has the obligation and responsibility to:
a. provide contribution and guarantee in the implementation of the administration of women's protection;
b. provide facilities and infrastructure to enhance efforts for the fulfillment of rights and protection of women; and
c. be responsible for conducting prevention, risk reduction and handling of cases of women victims of violence, exploitation, human trafficking.

Article 25
(1) The Mayor conducts guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision of the protection of women.
(2) The Mayor may delegate the guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision, as referred to in paragraph (1), to the Regional Apparatus Organization that carries out the main duties and functions in the field of the protection of women.
(3) The procedures and mechanisms for guidance, coordination, implementation, and supervision shall be further regulated by a Mayor Regulation.

Article 17
(1) In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family life, society, nation, and state, women must be empowered.
(2) The empowerment of women as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed towards obtaining their opportunities and rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in economic, socio-cultural, political, and legal activities.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

CHAPTER III
SCOPE
Article 3
The Scope of Protection of Women includes: a. Prevention;
b. Services; and
c. Empowerment.

CHAPTER VI
EVALUATION, REPORTING
AND ACCOUNTABILITY
Article 27
(1) OPD conducts prevention services, risk reduction services and case handling services for women who are victims.
(2) OPD that implements the administration of women's protection is obligated to carry out evaluation and prepare accountability reports to the Mayor.

Article 23
(1) The community is responsible for carrying out prevention, risk reduction, and handling of cases of women who are victims of violence, exploitation, and trafficking in persons.
(2) The community's responsibility as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women;
b. providing information and/or reporting to law enforcement officers or the competent authorities if acts of violence occur;
c. protecting victims; and
d. providing emergency assistance.

Article 21
The implementation of women's empowerment in the field of law as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (2) includes:
a. increasing awareness and knowledge in the field of law through communication, information and education services; and
b. facilitation of access and legal consultation services.

GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 24
The business sector has the obligation and responsibility to:
a. provide contribution and guarantee in the implementation of the administration of women's protection;
b. provide facilities and infrastructure to enhance efforts for the fulfillment of rights and protection of women; and
c. be responsible for conducting prevention, risk reduction and handling of cases of women victims of violence, exploitation, human trafficking.

Article 26
(1) The implementation of women's protection services is carried out in an integrated manner by UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
(2) The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by the Mayor's Regulation.

MAYOR OF BANDAR LAMPUNG
LAMPUNG PROVINCE
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANDAR LAMPUNG CITY
NUMBER: 03 YEAR 2019
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN
BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD
MAYOR OF BANDAR LAMPUNG,

Considering : a. that in the context of fulfilling the constitutional rights of women, every citizen has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity, has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence and to improve the quality of life of women which is one of the responsibilities of the Regional Government; b. that in the effort to fulfill women's rights, efforts need to be made by families, communities, and the Regional Government, as referred to in letter a, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women; In View of : 1. Article 18 paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia; 2. Law Number 28 Year 1959 concerning Stipulation of Emergency Law Number 4 Year 1956 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1956 Number 55, Emergency Law Number 5 Year 1956 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1956 Number 57) concerning Establishment of Level II Regions Including Municipality Within the Level I Region of South Sumatra as Law (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1959 Number 73, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 1821); 3. Article 14
(1) Legal assistance constitutes legal services provided by legal companions and advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Accompanying and/or defending in every legal handling process;
b. preparing reports on the progress of legal handling.

Article 23
(1) The community is responsible for carrying out prevention, risk reduction, and handling of cases of women who are victims of violence, exploitation, and trafficking in persons.
(2) The community's responsibility as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women;
b. providing information and/or reporting to law enforcement officers or the competent authorities if acts of violence occur;
c. protecting victims; and
d. providing emergency assistance.

CHAPTER VI
EVALUATION, REPORTING
AND ACCOUNTABILITY
Article 27
(1) OPD conducts prevention services, risk reduction services and case handling services for women who are victims.
(2) OPD that implements the administration of women's protection is obligated to carry out evaluation and prepare accountability reports to the Mayor.

Article 25
(1) The Mayor conducts guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision of the protection of women.
(2) The Mayor may delegate the guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision, as referred to in paragraph (1), to the Regional Apparatus Organization that carries out the main duties and functions in the field of the protection of women.
(3) The procedures and mechanisms for guidance, coordination, implementation, and supervision shall be further regulated by a Mayor Regulation.

Second Part

CHAPTER III
SCOPE
Article 3
The Scope of Protection of Women includes: a. Prevention;
b. Services; and
c. Empowerment.

Article 16
(1) Social reintegration constitutes efforts to reunite victims with their family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Economic and social empowerment;
b. Education; and
c. Monitoring and/or further guidance.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 23
(1) The community is responsible for carrying out prevention, risk reduction, and handling of cases of women who are victims of violence, exploitation, and trafficking in persons.
(2) The community's responsibility as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women;
b. providing information and/or reporting to law enforcement officers or the competent authorities if acts of violence occur;
c. protecting victims; and
d. providing emergency assistance.

Article 14
(1) Legal assistance constitutes legal services provided by legal companions and advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Accompanying and/or defending in every legal handling process;
b. preparing reports on the progress of legal handling.

Article 24
The business sector has the obligation and responsibility to:
a. provide contribution and guarantee in the implementation of the administration of women's protection;
b. provide facilities and infrastructure to enhance efforts for the fulfillment of rights and protection of women; and
c. be responsible for conducting prevention, risk reduction and handling of cases of women victims of violence, exploitation, human trafficking.

d. providing emergency assistance.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 16
(1) Social reintegration constitutes efforts to reunite victims with their family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Economic and social empowerment;
b. Education; and
c. Monitoring and/or further guidance.

SCOPE

b. Services; and
c. Empowerment.

Article 21
The implementation of women's empowerment in the field of law as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (2) includes:
a. increasing awareness and knowledge in the field of law through communication, information and education services; and
b. facilitation of access and legal consultation services.

Article 14
(1) Legal assistance constitutes legal services provided by legal companions and advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. Accompanying and/or defending in every legal handling process;
b. preparing reports on the progress of legal handling.

Article 17
(1) In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family life, society, nation, and state, women must be empowered.
(2) The empowerment of women as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed towards obtaining their opportunities and rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in economic, socio-cultural, political, and legal activities.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.

Article 24
The business sector has the obligation and responsibility to:
a. provide contribution and guarantee in the implementation of the administration of women's protection;

Article 23

(2) The community's responsibility as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women;
b. providing information and/or reporting to law enforcement officers or the competent authorities if acts of violence occur;
c. protecting victims; and
d. providing emergency assistance.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

Article 26
(1) The implementation of women's protection services is carried out in an integrated manner by UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
(2) The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by the Mayor's Regulation.

Article 13
(1) Social rehabilitation constitutes services aimed at restoring and developing the capabilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can perform their social functions properly.
(2) Services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of:
a. providing assistance during the case handling process;
b. conducting counseling.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bandar Lampung.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bandar Lampung City.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Bandar Lampung.
5. Protection is all preventive actions, services and empowerment to protect and guarantee the rights of women from acts of violence.
6. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering either physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.
8. Human Trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
9. Victim is a person who experiences misery and/or threat of violence resulting in suffering either physically and/or psychologically either directly or indirectly.
10. Prevention is the effort of regional government and society in creating conditions that prevent the occurrence of violence, mistreatment, exploitation and neglect and trafficking against women.
11. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
12. Empowerment is an effort to strengthen women to be able to conduct business/endeavor and work independently.
13. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a Regional Technical Implementation Unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Women and Children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
14. Safe House is a temporary residence, used to provide protection to victims.

CHAPTER VI
EVALUATION, REPORTING
AND ACCOUNTABILITY
Article 27
(1) OPD conducts prevention services, risk reduction services and case handling services for women who are victims.
(2) OPD that implements the administration of women's protection is obligated to carry out evaluation and prepare accountability reports to the Mayor.

Article 17
(1) In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize gender equality and justice in family life, society, nation, and state, women must be empowered.
(2) The empowerment of women as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed towards obtaining their opportunities and rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in economic, socio-cultural, political, and legal activities.

Article 24
The business sector has the obligation and responsibility to:
a. provide contribution and guarantee in the implementation of the administration of women's protection;
b. provide facilities and infrastructure to enhance efforts for the fulfillment of rights and protection of women; and
c. be responsible for conducting prevention, risk reduction and handling of cases of women victims of violence, exploitation, human trafficking.

Article 26
(1) The implementation of women's protection services is carried out in an integrated manner by UPTD PPA and in coordination with OPD and related Agencies or institutions in accordance with the field of Women's services.
(2) The implementation of service delivery as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by the Mayor's Regulation.

Article 25
(1) The Mayor conducts guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision of the protection of women.
(2) The Mayor may delegate the guidance, coordination of implementation, and supervision, as referred to in paragraph (1), to the Regional Apparatus Organization that carries out the main duties and functions in the field of the protection of women.
(3) The procedures and mechanisms for guidance, coordination, implementation, and supervision shall be further regulated by a Mayor Regulation.

CHAPTER IX
CLOSING PROVISIONS
Article 29
This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.
In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Bandar Lampung City.
